def generate_inputs(device):
    M, K, N = 8205, 2949, 5921
    
    c = 10000.0  # Large value for numerical instability
    
    # A with alternating large values
    A = torch.zeros(M, K, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
    A[:, ::2] = c
    A[:, 1::2] = -c
    
    # B structured for cancellation: even indices 1475, odd indices 1474
    # Alternating sum with all 1s = 1475 - 1474 = 1
    # Compensate by increasing odd values: 1475 - 1474*(1+eps) = 0 when eps = 1/1474
    epsilon = 1.0 / 1474.0
    B = torch.ones(K, N, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
    B[1::2, :] = 1.0 + epsilon
    
    # Small noise to prevent exact zeros while keeping results tiny
    torch.manual_seed(77777)
    noise_scale = 1e-7
    B = B + torch.randn(K, N, device=device, dtype=torch.float32) * noise_scale
    
    return [A, B]
